insight.headline: Taxes Recalculated
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated on an unfulfilled order. This change affects orders updated through the GraphQL Admin API. The recalculation occurs against the new destination.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderUpdate mutation should be aware that taxes will be recalculated when the shipping address is changed. This may impact the total cost of the order and should be considered when updating orders. The GraphQL Admin API will return the updated tax amounts after the mutation is applied. Ensure your app handles these changes correctly, especially if you're displaying order totals or handling tax calculations.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see accurate tax calculations for orders when the shipping address is updated, ensuring compliance with tax regulations and avoiding potential disputes over incorrect tax charges.
insight.why_it_matters: Accurate tax calculations are crucial for merchants to comply with tax laws and avoid financial penalties. This change ensures that Shopify's platform reflects the most up-to-date tax information when orders are updated.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance storefront functionality and developer tools

themes.title: Storefront Enhancements
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and WebMCP tools are available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, enabling AI agents to interact with online stores. The updateCart standard action updates cart attributes, and a new shopify:cart:attributes-update event fires whenever an attributes update is initiated.

themes.title: Developer Tools and Hydrogen
themes.detail: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing deployment of Hydrogen storefronts. The CLI has been updated to version 4.6.1, which serves UI extension source maps during app development. The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment.
